comments.text: One million year old bones!!!?, kwani for how long has humans been on  the earth? I thought we've been for some hundred thousand years only!!!

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Good question to ask - modern humans (Homo sapiens) go back roughly 300,000 years, but our wider human family tree (genus Homo, including earlier species like Homo erectus and Homo habilis) stretches back over 2 million years, which is likely what those older bones represent.
